Path: instrument — CI time-to-green for every lane (area:devpath, the road's dev/verify step) | none — no platform-checklist item asserts CI speed | priority:p2 (North Star rule 3: an instrument card inherits along the chain; the queue position is set by the maintainer directive below) | none

Triage: lands in domain:ui (objectui) — .github/workflows/repo-gates.yml; labels `tooling` · `area:devpath` · `priority:p2` · `pm:queue`; type Task (the create door carries no type flag — triage sets it on first touch); rationale: the one build-carrying job with no Turbo restore cold-builds ./packages/* for 261 s on every PR, push and queue build; the in-tree pattern to copy is performance-budget.yml:254-262; it becomes the small-PR critical path once the affected fast path runs.

Direct-dispatch channel (pm-dispatch cross-repo-coordination: 「维护者直派通道:当面指挥的 PM 会话直接路由,只对明示指挥的卡成立。直派的审计评论逐字引用授权指令。」). The authorising words, verbatim and untranslated — the maintainer, 2026-10-23, replying to the director seat's offer:

> seat: (a) 我按 PM 流程把 A1–A5、B1–B3 立成卡进队列(英文卡面、带 Governing text: 与工作量列),由 os-dev 派发;(b) 先只要这份报告,总监席决裁批照原计划开。
> maintainer: 同意，立卡

The word covers filing and dispatch; the lane seat dispatches this card under it even while a p1 sits in the lane queue (优先序:维护者裁决 > 北极星). Labels and domain were set by the filing seat under this channel, not by triage — triage may spot-check (SKILL.md 域车道 例外二).

Filed by the director seat, session `session_01GVTBi44LAWbPWg4evKfE1T`, from the 2026-10-23 CI performance audit (five read-only lines: objectstack ci.yml + lint.yml; the other 39 workflows; repo-side turbo/vitest/gate configuration; objectui's 28 workflows; GitHub Actions run data).

Written 2026-10-23T04:45Z by the director seat.

Claim: PM loop round 3 · 2026-10-23T11:44Z
Session: `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj` (`domain:ui` seat 1; an S card done by a sub-agent of this seat, dispatched by this project's coordinator)
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-13348-repo-gates-turbo-cache`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-13348`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: `.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` (a Turbo cache restore before the build step, save + prune on push to main, mirroring `performance-budget.yml:254-262`) (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent` (a sub-agent of this seat, base `origin/main` `2c4e5f5`), `model: default`, `effort: medium` (S)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: objectui's Repo Gates job, the one build-carrying job with no `.turbo/cache` restore | every objectui PR, push and merge-group build | 261 s of a 7.4 min job, the longest job once the affected fast path works
Serial constraints cleared: none (no open claim or PR of this lane names these paths)

**Governed face:** `.github/workflows/**` is on objectui's governed surface. The PR stops at draft until an authorized approval (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) is on record, and its review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by an isolated at-tier subagent of this seat. ⛔ No seat approves it. Maintainer directive carried by the card: 「同意，立卡」 (2026-10-23).

Surface revision · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj` · 2026-10-23T11:59Z

Seat: domain:ui#1
Clause-②: no
File surface: `.github/workflows/repo-gates.yml`, `scripts/__tests__/check-action-ref-convention.test.ts` (its pinned list of repo-gates.yml `uses:` refs gains the Turbo restore and save, in file order), `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (one sentence in the Repo Gates section naming `scripts/report-turbo-cache.mjs`, which `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` requires for every first-party command a job runs)

Why: the sub-agent stopped before pushing on both. Each is a pin that names what the workflow runs, and each failed until it was updated to the new step list. Neither changes a gate's behaviour. No changeset is owed (`check-changeset-presence`: no released package source touched).

## LANDED

objectui#13348 由 PR objectui#13360 合入 main，合并提交 `3688e5cd4af81a607d65165a23889f6b562864e3`（2026-10-24T02:21Z，经合并队列）。记录于 2026-10-24T02:21Z。

Seat: domain:ui#1

Repo Gates 任务加 Turbo 构建缓存：构建前恢复，只有 push 到 main 时才保存；PR 和合并队列的跑只读不写。提速要等 main 第一次保存缓存后才看得到，席位会用之后第一个 PR 跑的 `Turbo cache` 注记核验。

撤下 `pm:dispatched`。席位核对见 PR comment 6364653339。
